findings.observed: The problem (unknown school agreements) is directly addressed by the museum outcome which serves to explain these agreements to new students.
findings.expected: Clear linkage between problem, purpose, and outcome.

findings.observed: The question '¿Cómo podemos explicar y poner en práctica nuestros acuerdos para convivir mejor?' is accessible to both 1st and 3rd grades.
findings.expected: Question must be accessible to all involved grades.

findings.observed: The project explicitly states 'Reflexionar sobre las piezas sin exposición ni traslado' in the apply stage. It fails the itinerant requirement as it does not move between at least two viable spaces/audiences.
findings.expected: Museum must be itinerant with movement between at least two viable spaces or audiences.

findings.observed: 1st grade explains situations (F3-DHC-1-010) and 3rd grade inquires/contrasts practices (F4-DHC-3-001) to build the museum pieces.
findings.expected: Full development of PDA cognitive actions.

findings.observed: Evidence includes drawings with dictated explanations (1st) and registered consultations/comparisons (3rd).
findings.expected: Evidence must match the cognitive performance of the PDA.

findings.observed: Both grades contribute interdependent pieces (drawings and consultation records) to a single museum outcome.
Each stage (frame, investigate, apply) produces a specific artifact (questions, shared_explanations, completion).
findings.expected: Each advance must have operation, artifact, and evidence.

findings.observed: The project involves inquiry, production, and application, not just reflection.
findings.expected: Operations must perform the methodology; reflection is not a substitute for intervention.

findings.observed: Complexity is adjusted: 1st grade uses visual/dictated support, 3rd grade uses written records.
findings.expected: Complexity and support must be appropriate to grades.

findings.observed: 3 sessions of 90 minutes are sufficient for the defined scope of two school agreements.
findings.expected: Feasibility based on complexity and stages.

findings.observed: 1st and 3rd grades work on their respective PDAs without inheriting requirements from each other.
findings.expected: No inheritance of contents or requirements between grades.

findings.observed: LTG is absent; justified by the context of consulting internal school experiences.
findings.expected: LTG must be pertinent or justified if absent.
